description: “Cycling in New South Wales: What the data tells us” and related data is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Premier's Council for Active Living. Background data includes bike routes and plans by LGA. Coverage: NSW Premier's Council for Active Living. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Premier's Council for Active Living. Its tags are bicycles, bikepaths, cycling, transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
